def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    result = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            # Get diagonal neighbors with toroidal wrapping
            neighbors = [
                state[(r - 1) % n][(c + 1) % n],  # NE
                state[(r - 1) % n][(c - 1) % n],  # NW
                state[(r + 1) % n][(c + 1) % n],  # SE
                state[(r + 1) % n][(c - 1) % n],  # SW
            ]
            d_q = neighbors.count(2)
            result[r][c] = d_q % 3
    return result
